title: MerVik’s Vanilla+
description: Lightweight Fabric client modpack with 70+ mods focused on performance, shaders, visuals and quality-of-life improvements while keeping the vanilla Minecraft experience intact.
body:
## MerVik’s Vanilla+

A lightweight Fabric client modpack with 70+ mods focused on performance, quality-of-life improvements, and optional visual enhancements while preserving the vanilla Minecraft experience.

![Visual](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85f3c82e3fb061f25754e55a668f5eb845f2ddab.png)

### Performance first

This pack significantly improves FPS, reduces stuttering, and fixes many vanilla engine issues using modern optimization mods. Designed for smooth performance on low- and mid-end systems while scaling well on powerful PCs.

### Vanilla+ visuals

Optional shaders, dynamic lighting, improved weather, particles, animations, and connected textures enhance the game’s visuals without changing its vanilla feel.

![ sunset](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f73f70402ea0d7463f008c181681c0d71a4a2aa6.png)

### Quality of life

Includes small but impactful improvements such as zoom, better chat, shulker previews, freecam, NBT tools, and a cleaner mod menu — making gameplay more convenient and smooth.

![rain](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f20db56c518a1df8379a50d20716231da97b6df6.png)

### Works everywhere

This is a client-side modpack with no gameplay-altering content, making it compatible with most servers and singleplayer worlds.

![Second-person perspective](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0885e12adf151cf9c4f74698b8bf7f935f0b2f88.png)

### Built on Fabric

Powered by the Fabric mod loader for fast updates, high compatibility, and strong performance optimization.
